info.title: DataDrive API
info.description: REST API of DataDrive. Authenticate with the session cookie or a bearer token from /auth/login.

get.summary: List the live children of a drive root or folder
List the trash of a drive (editors and managers)

post.summary: Move a node into a folder of the same drive (parentId null = drive root)
Move a node to the trash
Restore a node from the trash

get.summary: Recently modified files in all my drives
Search by name in all my drives (or one drive)

delete.summary: Remove the star of an item

get.summary: The folders above an item, from the drive root down

put.summary: Upload a file (creates it, or adds a version if the name exists). Body: raw bytes.

get.summary: Download the current version of a file as raw bytes
My drives with role and usage

patch.summary: Change quota and settings of a drive (admin)

get.summary: List members of a team folder (manager or admin)

put.summary: Add or change a member (manager or admin)
Add a user to a group (admin)

delete.summary: Remove a user from a group (admin)

get.summary: The version history of a file, newest first

post.summary: Make an old version the current one again (copies it as a new version)

get.summary: Download one version of a file as raw bytes
